project_description: Add an opt-in agent-loop breach prevention layer that treats backend terminal events as provisional until transport recovery and, for eligible clean stops, semantic completion verification have resolved. Preserve streaming output while preventing premature A-side terminal publication; reuse existing stream recovery for pre-output transport retries; safely continue post-output interruptions from retained canonical trajectory without replaying committed output or side effects; use a separate bounded auxiliary verifier for clean-stop decisions; inject only conditional internal recovery instructions that cannot be mistaken for new user intent or approval; and enforce bounded progress, exactly-once terminal ownership, protocol neutrality, observability, and conservative allow-stop behavior on uncertainty. Preserve existing behavior when disabled and do not weaken Go-LIP's no-silent-failover-after-output-commit invariant.
